This is not your average supermarket honey; it is a pure, raw, and unprocessed nectar, meticulously and sustainably harvested by indigenous communities deep within the protected Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve. Known locally as “Kattu Then,” this wild forest honey is a potent liquid gold that bridges the gap between gourmet flavor and ancient healing.

The Power of Nilgiri Forest Wild Bitter Honey: Nature’s Rare Harvest

What sets our Wild Bitter Honey apart is its complex, sophisticated flavor profile. Unlike the sugary sweetness of clover or wildflower honey, this variety offers a bold, tangy, and characteristically bitter finish. This unique taste is derived from the nectar of medicinal forest flora, specifically the Jamun (Indian Blackberry) and native Wild Neem blossoms. These plants infuse the honey with bioactive compounds, making it a staple in traditional wellness for those seeking natural immunity boosters and digestible superfoods.

Authentic Nilgiri Sourcing & Tribal Heritage

At Sannara, we pride ourselves on delivering authentic Ooty products that honor the land. Our honey is collected from the massive combs of the Giant Rock Bee (Apis dorsata), found on high-altitude cliffs and towering jungle trees. The harvesting process is a sacred tradition performed by the Irula and Kurumba tribes. These indigenous experts use smoke and traditional climbing techniques to gather the honey without harming the bee colonies. By choosing this product, you are supporting ethical sourcing and the livelihoods of tribal communities, ensuring that the biodiversity of the Nilgiris remains protected for generations to come.

Pure, Raw, and Unprocessed: Straight from Hive to Jar

Modern honey processing often involves high-heat pasteurization and micro-filtration, which strips away the “living” elements of the honey. We do things differently. Our Nilgiri Forest Honey remains:
  • Unheated & Raw: Retaining all naturally occurring enzymes, antioxidants, and vitamins.
  • Rich in Bee Pollen: We use a simple single-filter method that allows microscopic bee pollen and propolis to remain in the jar, providing maximum nutritional value.
  • 100% Natural: Free from added sugars, preservatives, or artificial flavors.
Note: Because this is real raw honey, it may naturally crystallize. This is a hallmark of purity and high pollen content.

Medicinal Benefits & Wellness Uses

Renowned for its therapeutic properties, Wild Bitter Honey is often sought after for its health-giving benefits:
  • Antioxidant Powerhouse: Helps fight oxidative stress and supports cellular health.
  • Blood Sugar Management: Traditionally used in smaller quantities as a more stable alternative to refined sugars.
  • Respiratory Support: A classic remedy for soothing sore throats and seasonal coughs.

How to Use This Gourmet Forest Honey

To fully appreciate the nuanced flavor of the Nilgiris, we recommend:
  1. A Morning Tonic: Mix one teaspoon with lukewarm water and lemon to detoxify your system.
  2. Gourmet Pairings: Use it as a glaze for roasted vegetables or a bold drizzle over artisanal cheeses.
  3. Sugar Alternative: Add a complex depth to your Nilgiri Teas or coffee.

For over three generations, Darmona has nurtured the craft of producing high-altitude South Indian teas. Grown in the mist-covered Nilgiri hills, our tea bushes benefit from unique microclimates that yield subtle aromatics and natural strength.

Darmona Premium Dust Tea is meticulously processed from handpicked leaves into ultra-fine particles, allowing an immediate release of bold flavor and deep amber color. Whether you prefer a morning wake-up call or an evening refreshment, Darmona Dust Tea delivers an authentic estate-to-cup experience defined by consistency, strength, and timeless tradition.

Quick Feature:

Feature Details
Tea Type CTC Dust Tea
Origin Nilgiris (Blue Mountains), South India
Strength Strong / Full-bodied
Best Enjoyed Hot with milk and sweetener
Available Sizes 250g, 500g
Brewing Time 2–3 minutes (Simmered/Boiled)
Shipping Dispatched within 5–7 business days
